requirements.label: Diploma equivalence and individual assessment
requirements.details: The school-leaving diploma must qualify as equivalent to Dutch VWO. UM decides on unlisted diplomas individually after receiving the complete online application, documents and any applicable handling fee. Programme subject requirements are assessed separately.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: US diploma · College Board AP routes
requirements.details: Present the US high school diploma with either four AP examinations scoring at least 3 each or three AP examinations scoring at least 4 each. UM excludes Capstone, Research and Seminar. Upload the list of AP exams already taken and those planned. The chosen degree may require particular AP subjects.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: US diploma earned abroad · school accreditation
requirements.details: For a US diploma earned at an international school outside the United States, the school offering the American curriculum must hold US accreditation.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: US diploma · first-year university alternative
requirements.details: As an alternative to the AP-based diploma equivalence route, complete all required courses or credits of the first year of a university bachelor’s degree before the UM programme begins. Submit a transcript identifying the university, degree, major, completed subjects and subjects in progress.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: UK GCE · grades and distinct subjects
requirements.details: Present three academic A levels at grades A–C together with GCSEs in three different subjects. Mathematics and Further Mathematics together count as one A-level subject. AS levels cannot replace a missing qualifying full A level. Submit the list of A levels being taken.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: UK GCE · accepted academic subjects
requirements.details: UM lists biology, chemistry, classical studies, computing, divinity, economics, geography, history, information technology, law, mathematics or further mathematics, marine science, modern languages, physics, psychology and sociology. It evaluates other A-level subjects individually.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: UK · AICE and Scottish qualifications
requirements.details: An AICE award may qualify with three academic A levels graded A–C. For the Scottish Qualifications Certificate, UM lists four or more Highers and two Advanced Highers at grades A–C.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: South Africa · National Senior Certificate
requirements.details: Average at least 70% over seven subjects. The certificate must confirm eligibility for bachelor’s study.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: Ghana · senior certificate and university study
requirements.details: Present six West African Senior School Certificate subjects at A1–C6 and complete every course or credit required for the first year of a university bachelor’s degree.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: Uganda · UACE and university study
requirements.details: Present the UACE with six subjects, at least one principal pass, and successful completion of all required first-year bachelor’s courses or credits at university.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: Zimbabwe · A and O levels with university study
requirements.details: Present at least two A-level subjects and five O-level exam subjects at A–C, together with the successful completion of all required first-year credits or courses of a university bachelor’s degree.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: Brazil · secondary certificate
requirements.details: With the Certificado de Conclusão de Ensino Médio, UM lists a final-year average above 8.0 and an ENEM average above 600. Another route combines the certificate with completion of every required first-year bachelor’s course or credit at university.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: Spain · Bachiller and university entrance exam
requirements.details: The final school-year average must be at least 7.0, with a passing PAU, EBAU or EVAU result. Identify the modalidad in your documents. For a foreign diploma UM assesses the original award and excludes Spanish homologación with PCE as an admission route.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: Belgium · study hours and profile evidence
requirements.details: Show the weekly hours for each school subject in the final two years. If the school curriculum has tracks, identify the study direction followed.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: France · speciality subjects
requirements.details: Provide a school statement identifying the spécialité subjects studied in première and terminale. UM recognises the general baccalauréat and BFI and considers the technological baccalauréat individually.

source.title: Maastricht University · VWO-equivalent diplomas 2027/28

requirements.label: European Baccalaureate · examination evidence
requirements.details: For the Schola Europaea diploma, report the subjects taken as final written and oral examinations.

requirements.label: September 2027 · application deadlines
requirements.details: EU/EEA and Swiss applicants have until 1 May 2027 at 23:59. For all other nationalities the deadline is 1 April 2027 at 23:59. The university gives these times as CET. Follow the programme page for deadlines applying to individual documents.

source.title: Maastricht University · Biomedical Sciences · September 2027 admission

requirements.label: September 2027 · selective programme deadline
requirements.details: All applicants must register through Studielink by 15 January 2027 at 23:59 CET and complete the admission tasks due at that stage in MyApplication.

source.title: Maastricht University · Medicine · September 2027 admission

requirements.label: Medicine · portfolio and selection day
requirements.details: Use MyApplication to submit the portfolio, its addendum and the homework assignment before 16:00 CET on 22 January 2027. The on-site selection day in Maastricht is 27 February and tests cognitive and interpersonal skills.

source.title: Maastricht University · Medicine · September 2027 admission

requirements.label: Medicine · Dutch proficiency evidence
requirements.details: The medicine schedule gives 31 August 2027 as the deadline for proving Dutch proficiency. This task has its own date after the January application deadline.

source.title: Maastricht University · Medicine · September 2027 admission

requirements.label: Brain Science · selection examination
requirements.details: Complete the selection exam by 1 March 2027 at 16:59 CET. Ranking numbers appear in Studielink on 15 April. An offered place must be accepted within 14 days.

source.title: Maastricht University · Brain Science · September 2027 admission

requirements.label: Economics and Business Economics · International Classroom Essay
requirements.details: A passing International Classroom Essay is required. The early essay deadline is 15 January 2027 at 23:59 CET. All applicants must apply in Studielink and complete their admission tasks by 15 March 2027 at 23:59 CET.

source.title: Maastricht University · Economics and Business Economics · September 2027 admission

requirements.label: International Business · selection documents
requirements.details: Submit the International Classroom Essay in MyApplication. It has six questions and must be assessed as sufficient for ranking. Selection also uses the certified statement of grades and CV with supporting documents. The result and ranking number are published on 15 April 2027.

source.title: Maastricht University · International Business · September 2027 admission
